en.WelcomeMsg: Kia ora, Welcome to the 0800 What’s Up Chat service :)
en.GoodbyeMsg:
The counsellor has ended the chat. Thank you for reaching out. 
If you or anyone you know becomes unsafe following our chat today, please call 111 or your local mental health crisis team - https://www.healthnz.govt.nz/health-topics/mental-health/crisis-assessment-teams . 
We’re glad you connected.
en.EndChatMsg:
You’ve ended the chat. Thanks for getting in touch. 
If you or anyone you know becomes unsafe following our chat today, please call 111 or your local mental health crisis team - https://www.healthnz.govt.nz/health-topics/mental-health/crisis-assessment-teams. 
 If you need support again, we’re here for you.
en.ClosedOutOfShift:
Kia ora!  We're really glad you reached out.
Sorry we missed you — we'd really like to hear more about what’s been going on for you. You deserve support, and we’re here to listen. 
Our chats are free, and we’re open every day from 11am to 10:30pm. You can also call us on 0800 942 8787 between 11am and 11pm.  We’d really love to hear from you again when we’re open. In the meantime, please call 111 if you are unsafe.  You can also reach out to one of these free services if you want to talk to someone sooner:
Other services:
Youthline – Free call 0800 37 66 33 or text 234 (24/7, for ages 12–24)
1737 – Free call or text 1737 (24/7)
Anxiety NZ – Free call 0800 269 4389 (24/7)
Take care of yourself for now -  we hope to chat with you soon
